name: gearbox-browser-app
//theiaPlugins: Git. Theia 1.75 does not ship `@theia/git` -- its last release was 1.61.0-next.8 -- so git is the VS Code extension, running in the plugin host. `git-base` is not optional: `vscode.git` depends on it. Versions are pinned in the URL, so an upgrade is an edit somebody makes on purpose rather than a drift. Fetched by `npm run plugins`, deliberately not by `build`: it downloads a third-party artefact over the network, and the precedent in this repo is `npx playwright install chromium` -- an explicit step, documented, never a postinstall.

preferences.//files.watcherExclude: Not optional once a workspace is opened. The roots are two Rust checkouts, and `target/` in either is multi-gigabyte -- Theia would walk both. `.gearbox/` is generated output, regenerated wholesale, so watching it reports churn nobody acts on.
